top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs two mature, independently confirmed and conceptually distinct achievements: the PROTAC concept of event-driven degradation by induced proximity (Crews, Deshaies) and pKa-tuned ionizable lipid nanoparticles for nucleic-acid delivery (Cullis), which is delivery chemistry rooted in lipid self-assembly and non-bilayer phase behaviour that the 2023 Medicine prize did not cover. The Cullis attribution is a judgment and is the weakest element, so I rank the single-part B020 with Ciulli (P001) next, then the Handa variant (P002), then the Shokat pairing (P004), all above no award.
recusal_note: No personal or institutional tie to any credited name; my research on lipid self-assembly and membranes is scientifically close to B049 (ionizable lipid nanoparticles), disclosed for transparency, and I share Lund University with the chair and Peter Somfai.
